core_obligations: Factor the shriek: choose the factorization of the homomorphism through a polynomial ring that defines the shriek functor, and note that derived tensor product preserves each of the boundedness and coherence subcategories (proof lines 4642-4645)
The bounded below part: the internal hom factor preserves bounded below and bounded below coherent complexes by the cited finite-map statement, which gives part (1) (proof lines 4646-4648)

The perfect case: perfection makes the module perfect over the polynomial ring, so the restriction of the internal hom is the tensor product with a perfect complex represented by a finite complex of finite projectives and therefore preserves the bounded above and bounded coherent subcategories as well; restriction reflects these, which gives part (2) (proof lines 4649-4661)
proof_roadmap: 取定义 φ^! 所用的分解 R → P → A；张量积 - ⊗_R^L - 保持 D^+, D^+_Coh, D^-, D^-_Coh, D^b_Coh。
(1)：RHom(A,-) 由有限映射下保持 D^+/D^+_Coh 的引理（exact-support-coherent）给出。
(2)：φ 完美 ⇒ A 是完美 P-模 ⇒ 限制到 D(P) 上 RHom_P(A,K) = E ⊗_P^L K（E 完美，可用有限投射复形表示）⇒ K 有界（上）即得 RHom_P(A,K) 有界（上）；限制函子反射这些子范畴 ⇒ 结论。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement collects the boundedness and coherence properties preserved by the upper shriek functor of a finite type homomorphism of Noetherian rings, with the bounded above properties requiring the homomorphism to be perfect (author lemma at source lines 4628-4639, label lemma-shriek-boundedness). The proof (source lines 4641-4662) decomposes the shriek through its defining factorization, observes that the tensor factor preserves every one of the subcategories, gets the bounded below part from the cited finite-map statement, and in the perfect case replaces the internal hom by the tensor product with a perfect complex represented by a finite complex of finite projectives, whence the bounded above and bounded coherent parts follow by reflection along restriction (proof lines 4649-4661). The perfect case reduction is the substance. H3.
